detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')
note: A unit-name operand is read off the value stack and used as a string without a type check, so a malformed stream that leaves a Number there reaches .toLowerCase() on undefined. vm/VM.ts, the UOM band. Bytecode-only: the compiler always pairs the opcode with a PUSH_STRING. FIXED: PUSH_NUMBER read numbers[opcodes[ip++]] with no bounds check, so an out-of-range index pushed a Value whose .value was undefined and CALL_AS_CONVERTER then called .toLowerCase() on it. vm/VM.ts now reads every constant-pool operand through poolIndex()/poolString(), and CALL_AS_CONVERTER takes its name through stringOperand(). Both raise MALFORMED_BYTECODE_* as a recoverable VALIDATION error naming the opcode and the index.
